user.title: Connect mySigen
user.description:
Link a mySigen account to a plant that is already set up in Sigenergy ESS.

**Use a separate account for Home Assistant.** Signing in here with the account you use in the app can sign the app out.

1. In the mySigen app, sign in as the system owner and open **Settings**.
2. Open the account or sharing section and choose to add a user.
3. Enter an email address that is not yet used in mySigen and choose **View and Edit**. A view-only user can read values but cannot start actions such as Hold Battery.
4. Activate the new account from the email mySigen sends and set its password.
5. Enter that email and password below.

Home Assistant stores the password so it can sign in again later.

data_description.plant_entry_id: The Modbus plant these cloud readings belong to.
data_description.region: The region your mySigen account was created in.

reconfigure.title: Change mySigen connection
reconfigure.description: Change the mySigen account, how often Home Assistant reads from mySigen, or whether it may control the battery.

data_description.password: Leave empty to keep the current password.
data_description.scan_interval: Between 15 and 60 seconds. Shorter intervals send more requests to mySigen.
data_description.allow_control: Lets Home Assistant actions start and cancel a timed battery override through mySigen. Off by default. The account needs View and Edit access.
data_description.allow_grid_disconnect: Adds a switch that takes the plant off the grid, so the home runs on battery and solar alone, and connects it again. Needs Allow battery control and a Sigenergy Gateway. Off by default.

error.invalid_auth: mySigen did not accept this email and password for the selected region.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach mySigen. Check the connection and try again.
error.login_rejected: mySigen answered with a server error instead of signing in. Newer mySigen versions may no longer accept this login method.
error.rate_limited: mySigen is limiting requests right now. Wait a few minutes and try again.
error.no_local_serial: Sigenergy ESS has not read this plant's inverter serial number yet, so the account cannot be checked. Try again when the plant is online.
error.no_cloud_serial: mySigen did not list any devices for this account, so it cannot be checked against the plant.
error.station_mismatch: This mySigen account belongs to a different system than the selected plant.
error.no_permission: mySigen signed this account in but did not allow it to read the battery settings. Check in the mySigen app that the system is shared with this account with View and Edit access.

abort.modbus_missing: Install and set up Sigenergy ESS (Sigenergy Local Modbus) first.
abort.modbus_too_old: Update Sigenergy ESS (Sigenergy Local Modbus) to 2.0.3 or later first.
abort.no_plant: Set up a plant in Sigenergy ESS first.
abort.already_configured: This plant already has a mySigen connection.

state.max_self_consumption: Use my own power first (maximum self-consumption)
state.fully_fed_to_grid: Send all solar to the grid (fully fed to grid)

battery_export.name: Allow battery to export to the grid

grid_disconnect.name: Disconnect from the grid (run on battery and solar)

plant_missing.title: The plant for {name} no longer exists
plant_missing.description: The Sigenergy ESS plant that {name} was linked to has been removed. Delete this mySigen connection and add it again for the plant you want.

station_mismatch.title: {name} belongs to a different system
station_mismatch.description: mySigen does not list this plant's inverter for the account used by {name}. This happens when the inverter was replaced, the system is no longer shared with the account, or the account was changed. Reconfigure the connection with an account that has access, or delete it and add it again.

no_permission.title: {name} is not allowed to read mySigen
no_permission.description: mySigen signed the account in but did not allow it to read the battery settings. Check in the mySigen app that the system is shared with this account with View and Edit access, then reload this connection.

start_battery_override.name: Start battery override
start_battery_override.description: Starts a timed battery override through mySigen. The plant ends it by itself when the time is up, even if Home Assistant is not running. Refused while another override or Remote EMS is active.

config_entry_id.name: mySigen connection
config_entry_id.description: Which connection to use. Can be left out when there is only one.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Minutes until the plant returns to its normal strategy (30 to 120).

power_limit.name: Power limit
power_limit.description: Most power in kW for a charge or discharge override. Leave out for no limit. Not used for hold or self-consumption.

cancel_battery_override.name: Cancel battery override
cancel_battery_override.description: Ends the running battery override, including one started in the mySigen app.
